name: MORVEN at Exampleville (synthetic tariff: a minimum, and towage not compulsory)
query: What will the Dutch general cargo coaster MORVEN (built 2009) pay at Exampleville? She is 2,600 GT and 1,450 NT, 3,800 DWT, 78 m long with a 12.5 m beam and a 5.1 m draft. She arrives on 2 June 2025 at 10:00 and sails on 5 June 2025 at 15:00, after 3.2 days alongside loading 3,000 tonnes of timber.

expected.label: Harbour dues
expected.note: ceil(1,450 / 100) = 15 units × 4.20 = 63.00; 3.2 days is not beyond the fifth day; raised to the 250.00 minimum per call; no reduction applies

expected.label: Pilotage
expected.note: compulsory from 70 m LOA; 78 m is in the up-to-100 m band: 1,200.00 × 2 operations, both in daytime

expected.label: Berth dues
expected.note: 78 m, all within the first 100 metres: 78 × 1.10 = 85.80 per day × ceil(3.2) = 4 days

expected.label: Waste reception fee
expected.note: flat per call; no exemption certificate

note: Towage is compulsory only over 120 m LOA and none was ordered, so it must not be charged; the expected total checks that.
